svg.text: clk / rst_n feed all instantiated children.
clear resets the selector and accumulators only.
Repeated net labels denote connected wires.
i_cleopatra is expanded to show u_dimc_dual, u_ctrl, and the 256 generated accumulator instances.
Stream interface arrows include both incoming data/valid and outgoing ready; the interfaces are not additional modules.
Reset: core_rst_n = rst_ni & ~clear_i (feeds local registers and i_cleopatra.rst_n).
Tile clear: acc_clear = (state_q == CLEAR_TILE) || (state_q == IDLE && start_i).
Result mapping: result_o[r][c] = acc[c*32+r]. result_pop counts scalar FIFO transfers, not external tile acceptance.
Child parameters: SECTION_WIDTH, INP_FIFO_DEPTH, WGT_FIFO_DEPTH, OUT_FIFO_DEPTH inherit the parent parameters.
Inputs: sel, m_readyn, m_psout, m_q, out_full
Same-name net labels connect across this block. FD and D are shared by both macros; control ports remain independent.
